text:
[LGRA.2.1.1] DS source files are UTF-8, and identifiers are Unicode:
the legal character set is `XID_Start`/`XID_Continue` narrowed by
`Identifier_Status=Allowed`, per [LNAM.2.2.1]. Every ASCII
identifier of the form `[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*` is legal
([LNAM.2.2.2]), and so is a great deal more.
